mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(current_setting('app.tenant_id',true),'') AS tenant,COALESCE(current_setting('app.platform_admin',true),'false') AS platform_admin
SELECT set_config('app.tenant_id',#{tenant},true) || set_config('app.platform_admin',#{platformAdmin},true)
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('agent-deployment:'||#{tenantId}::text||':'||COALESCE(#{integrationId}::text,'native')||':'||#{externalAgentRef},0))::text
SELECT FROM nw_agent_deployments WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND integration_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{integrationId} AND external_agent_ref=#{externalAgentRef}
SELECT FROM nw_agent_deployments WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND agent_id=#{agentId}
SELECT agent_id FROM nw_agent_deployments WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND agent_id IN #{agentId}
SELECT FROM nw_agent_deployments WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deployment_id=#{deploymentId}
SELECT FROM nw_agent_deployments WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND integration_id=#{integrationId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,agent_id

SELECT deployment_id,tenant_id,agent_id,revision, CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(bindings->'resource_bindings')='array' AND jsonb_typeof(bindings->'delegation_bindings')='array' AND jsonb_typeof(bindings->'parameters')='object' THEN jsonb_build_object( 'resources',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'slot_key',entry->'slot_key','capability_type',entry->'mount'->'capability_type') ORDER BY ordinal) FROM jsonb_array_elements(bindings->'resource_bindings') WITH ORDINALITY AS resource(entry,ordinal)),'[]'::jsonb), 'delegations',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(entry->'slot_key' ORDER BY ordinal) FROM jsonb_array_elements(bindings->'delegation_bindings') WITH ORDINALITY AS delegation(entry,ordinal)),'[]'::jsonb), 'parameter_keys',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(key ORDER BY key) FROM jsonb_object_keys(bindings->'parameters') AS parameter(key)),'[]'::jsonb)) ELSE NULL END::text AS binding_shape FROM nw_agent_deployments WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND definition_id=#{definitionId} ORDER BY deployment_id

SELECT r.revision,r.grant_id,r.grant_revision,r.bindings::text AS bindings,r.fingerprint,r.grant_chain::text AS grant_chain,c.response::text AS response FROM nw_agent_deployment_revisions r LEFT JOIN nw_agent_deployment_receipts c USING(deployment_id,revision) WHERE r.deployment_id=#{deploymentId} AND r.actor_ref=#{actorRef} AND r.command_ref=#{commandRef}

SELECT c.response::text FROM nw_agent_deployment_revisions r JOIN nw_agent_deployment_receipts c USING(deployment_id,revision) WHERE r.deployment_id=#{deploymentId} AND r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.revision=1 AND ((r.actor_ref=#{actorRef} AND r.command_ref=#{commandRef}) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nw_agent_deployment_create_requests q WHERE q.deployment_id=r.deployment_id AND q.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND q.actor_ref=#{actorRef} AND q.command_ref=#{commandRef}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_agent_deployment_create_requests(deployment_id,tenant_id,actor_ref,command_ref) VALUES(#{deploymentId},#{tenantId},#{actorRef},#{commandRef}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_agent_deployments SET bindings=CAST(#{bindings} AS jsonb),revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND agent_id=#{agentId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_agent_definition_grants WHERE grant_id=#{grantId} FOR SHARE
SELECT FROM nw_agent_definition_grants WHERE grant_id=#{grantId}
SELECT FROM nw_agent_definition_grants WHERE actor_ref=#{actorRef} AND request_key=#{requestKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_agent_definition_grants SET status='revoked',revision=revision+1,revoke_key=#{requestKey},revoke_fingerprint=#{fingerprint},revoked_by=#{actorRef},revoked_at=now() WHERE grant_id=#{grantId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND status='active'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_agent_definition_grants WHERE target_tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,grant_id
SELECT FROM nw_agent_deployments WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deployment_id=#{deploymentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM nw_agent_deployments WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND agent_id=#{agentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_agent_deployments SET grant_id=#{grantId},grant_revision=#{grantRevision},grant_chain=CAST(#{grantChain} AS jsonb),revision=revision+1,updated_at=now() WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deployment_id=#{deploymentId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT response::text FROM nw_agent_deployment_receipts WHERE deployment_id=#{deploymentId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_agent_deployment_receipts(deployment_id,revision,tenant_id,response) SELECT deployment_id,revision,tenant_id,CAST(#{response} AS jsonb) FROM nw_agent_deployment_revisions WHERE deployment_id=#{deploymentId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM nw_agent_definition_grant_revisions WHERE grant_id=#{grantId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_agent_definition_grants SET actions=#{actions},expires_at=#{expiresAt},allow_regrant=#{allowRegrant},remaining_depth=#{remainingDepth},revision=revision+1 WHERE grant_id=#{grantId} AND revision=#{expectedRevision} AND status='active'
mapper.select: SELECT fingerprint,response::text AS response FROM nw_agent_definition_grant_requests WHERE actor_ref=#{actor} AND command_ref=#{key}
SELECT id AS tenant_id,parent_tenant_id,status,relation_revision FROM nw_tenants WHERE id=#{tenantId}
SELECT id AS tenant_id,parent_tenant_id,status,relation_revision FROM nw_tenants WHERE id=#{tenantId} FOR SHARE

SELECT r.id AS relation_ref,r.revision FROM nw_institution_relation_revisions r JOIN nw_tenants t ON t.id=r.child_tenant_id AND t.relation_revision=r.revision WHERE r.child_tenant_id=#{child} AND r.parent_tenant_id=#{parent} AND t.parent_tenant_id=#{parent}
SELECT public.agent_grant_chain_available(CAST(#{chain} AS jsonb),#{tenantId},#{definitionId},#{action})
SELECT FROM nw_agent_definition_grants WHERE grantor_kind='tenant' AND grantor_tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,grant_id
